time.role_of_T: analytic existence/tail and predeclared compute endpoint; not a certified positive-growth horizon
time.policy: one forward trajectory; endpoints and checkpoints only; no interior-extremum promotion

analytic_tail.failure: fail closed; no Galerkin substitution and no parameter change

implicit_midpoint.method: implicit midpoint on the exact Leray-projected symmetric cubic Galerkin system
implicit_midpoint.rationalization: each accepted binary midpoint node is enclosed then replaced by the unique nearest rational with denominator 2^80; ties toward zero
implicit_midpoint.integrity_replay: exact finite-residual energy and helicity identities; divergence and Fourier reality

promotion.numerical_lead_rule: both levels satisfy all gates and each outward floating ratio lower bound is >201/100
promotion.full_pde_rule: outward rational cubature bounds satisfy 1000000*L_T > 8120601*U_0, where C_T>=L_T and C_0<=U_0 enclose integral |u|^3

full_euler_certificate.interface: cycle-265 equations (265.9)-(265.16), specialized to the singleton and K6
full_euler_certificate.reference: piecewise-affine path through the rationalized K6 implicit-midpoint nodes
full_euler_certificate.omitted_convolution: componentwise outward boxes for every retained mode, including retained-tail and tail-tail terms, using q at each slab end and 3D shell count 24*n^2+2
full_euler_certificate.picard: recentered strict inclusions (265.13) on every slab with exact rational interval arithmetic
full_euler_certificate.cubature: 64^3 Cartesian cells, directed rational Taylor bounds of fixed total degree 4, with retained endpoint boxes and the complete analytic tail; no trusted point values
full_euler_certificate.parser: ASCII JSON; exact keys; reduced rational strings; unknown or duplicate keys, missing modes, NaN, infinity, or reversed intervals fail closed

inviscid_transfer.derived_fields: certificate recomputes exact kappa1,kappa2,G,H and a positive rational outward B_up; it then supplies rational a,delta with a^3>=U_0 and (2*a+delta)^3<L_T
inviscid_transfer.acceptance: all transfer gates pass exactly and nu0_rat>0

resources.preflight: require at least 2 logical cores and 1024 MiB available memory before any trajectory; otherwise return ND270-RESOURCE-WALL without partial trajectory output
resources.checkpoint_policy: atomic write after each declared checkpoint; checkpoint data cannot alter parameters, gates, ordering, or horizon

stop_rules.on_numerical_failure: stop with bounded negative result for this manifest
stop_rules.on_certificate_failure: stop at the first failed exact interface and retain the failure artifact
